description: This donut-style pie chart represents a modality distribution, comparing the proportions of different audio and sound categories. The chart displays a total of seven distinct slices, which are visually arranged in descending order of size in a clockwise direction starting from the top. The largest segment is labeled "Speech (29.4%)" and is colored light purple, followed by "Mix-Sound-Speech (21.8%)" in a very pale purple. The next slices are "Music (20.6%)" in light purple, "Sound (16.5%)" in very pale purple, and "Mix-Music-Speech (8.2%)" in a darker shade of purple. The two smallest segments represent "Mix-Sound-Music-Speech (2.4%)" in medium purple and "Mix-Sound-Music (1.1%)" in a very light purple. There is no separate legend included; instead, the category labels and explicit percentages are positioned directly inside the five largest slices, while the two smallest segments use grey callout lines to connect exterior text labels to their respective narrow slices. None of the segments are visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting.
